name: Arrival Reconciliation
description: Repairs hub arrivals interrupted midway. The app writes an arrival as ordered steps with the HubReceipt as commit point; if the operator's browser dies the receipt stays appliedState=pending and the case snapshot is stale. Every step here is set-to-target, so replaying is safe.

schemaFields.name: parcelId
schemaFields.description: Denormalised so a parcel's arrival history needs no case join

schemaFields.name: ownerHubOrgId
schemaFields.description: Access key mirroring the owning case hub (hubOrgId is the receiving hub, which can differ)

schemaFields.name: hubOrgId
schemaFields.description: Access key for the receiving hub

schemaFields.name: incomingMovementId
schemaFields.description: IDEMPOTENCY KEY. The movement this arrival completes

schemaFields.name: appliedState
schemaFields.description: pending|applied. Drives the reconciliation sweep; this record is the commit point for an arrival

schemaFields.name: CreatedDate
schemaFields.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

schemaFields.name: LastUpdatedDate
schemaFields.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent update.

schemaFields.name: LastUpdatedBy
schemaFields.description: User ID of the last modifier.
